market.question: Will Venezuelan crude oil production reach 1.1m barrels per day in 2026?

assessment.reasoning: March 2026 production reported at ~988k-1,095k bpd; one source already at 1,095k. Trajectory is rising, with Chevron tripling exports and analysts targeting ~1.2m by year-end. With 9 months remaining, hitting 1.1m bpd in any month is highly likely. Estimate ~70-80%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether Chevron expansion sustains; reporting source variance (988k vs 1,095k).
